socratic_questions.question: 如果你在一场比赛中获得了第一名，你会站在哪里领奖？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 领奖台的最高位置代表着最好的成绩。

sentences: His name was ___ of the list, meaning he won the prize.

image_prompts: A lightbulb glowing above a stack of books, representing an idea
A speech bubble with a question mark inside, indicating contemplation
words.image_desc_en: A lightbulb representing an idea and a speech bubble with a question mark indicating contemplation.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个代表想法的灯泡和一个带有问号的语音气泡，表示沉思。
words.usage: n. 想法，思考；v. (think的过去式和过去分词) 思考，认为
words.collocations: a thought occurred to me, give thought to, lost in thought

examples.en: I had a thought about how we could improve our school club.
examples.cn: 我有一个关于如何改进我们学校俱乐部的主意。

examples.en: She thought the movie was very interesting, and she enjoyed it.
examples.cn: 她认为这部电影非常有趣，她很喜欢。

socratic_questions.question: 当你需要解决一个难题或者做一个决定时，你会做什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示你脑海中产生的想法和考虑。

sentences: He ___ carefully before answering the teacher's difficult question.

image_prompts: A snow-covered mountain peak against a clear blue sky, visible rocky terrain
A landscape featuring a tall mountain range with green trees at the base
words.image_desc_en: A mountain landscape.
words.image_desc_cn: 山脉景观。
words.collocations: mountain range, climb a mountain, mountain air
words.preposition_combos: on the mountain, near the mountain, at the foot of the mountain

examples.en: We plan to climb that mountain during our summer vacation.
examples.cn: 我们计划在暑假期间攀登那座山。

examples.en: The small village is located near the foot of the mountain.
examples.cn: 这个小村庄位于山脚下附近。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你想体验攀登的乐趣，并且看到壮丽的自然风光，你会选择去哪里？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个地方通常很高，并且有岩石和植被覆盖。

sentences: The view from the top of the ___ was absolutely breathtaking.

image_prompts: A checkered flag waving at a race's starting line, motion blur
A seedling emerging from soil, representing the beginning of growth
words.image_desc_en: A race begins with a checkered flag; a seedling represents a new start.
words.image_desc_cn: 方格旗标志着比赛的开始；幼苗象征着新的开始。
words.collocations: at the start of a game, at the start of a journey

examples.en: At the start of the movie, I didn't understand the plot.
examples.cn: 在电影开始时，我不理解情节。

examples.en: At the start, our team was losing, but we won later.
examples.cn: 起初，我们队输了，但后来我们赢了。

socratic_questions.question: 如果一场比赛刚刚开始，你会用什么短语来描述这个时间点？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 强调事情发生的初始阶段。

sentences: ___ of the class, the teacher introduced the new topic.

image_prompts: A finish line with a checkered flag waving, indicating the completion of a race
The last page of a thick novel, with a bookmark placed near the bottom
words.image_desc_en: A finish line and the last page of a book.
words.image_desc_cn: 终点线和书的最后一页。
words.collocations: at the end of, come to an end, end up

examples.en: The school year will end in July, before the summer holiday.
examples.cn: 学年将在七月结束，在暑假之前。

examples.en: We hope to end the project successfully by the deadline.
examples.cn: 我们希望在截止日期前成功结束这个项目。

socratic_questions.question: 一场赛跑的最终目标是什么？一本书的最后一部分叫什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 指事情的最后阶段或目标。

sentences: The movie will ___ in about ten minutes, so stay seated.

image_prompts: A finish line ribbon with runners' footprints leading up to it
A calendar page with a circle around the last day of the month
words.image_desc_en: Finish line and calendar marking the end
words.image_desc_cn: 终点线和日历标记结束
words.collocations: at the end of the day, at the end of the road, at the end of the year

examples.en: We will have a party at the end of the term.
examples.cn: 我们将在学期末举办一个派对。

examples.en: She felt tired at the end of the long journey.
examples.cn: 在漫长的旅程结束后，她感到很疲惫。

socratic_questions.question: 如果一场比赛跑到了最后冲过终点线，或者一年过完了最后一个月，你会怎么描述这个时间点？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 表示某个时间段或事件的最后阶段。

sentences: ___ of the movie, everyone was crying because it was so touching.

image_prompts: Dark clouds gathering over a turbulent sea, lightning striking the water
Uprooted trees and scattered debris after a violent wind event
words.image_desc_en: Images depicting a severe weather event with strong winds and heavy rain.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘强风和暴雨的恶劣天气事件的图像。
words.usage: n. / v. (过去式 stormed, 过去分词 stormed)
words.collocations: heavy storm, rain storm, storm warning, storm out
words.preposition_combos: in a storm, during the storm, after the storm

examples.en: A big storm is coming, so we should stay at home.
examples.cn: 一场大暴风雨即将来临，所以我们应该待在家里。

examples.en: He stormed out of the room after the argument with his father.
examples.cn: 在和父亲争吵后，他怒气冲冲地离开了房间。

socratic_questions.question: 当你看到乌云密布，狂风大作，电闪雷鸣时，你觉得发生了什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这种天气通常伴随着强降水和破坏性的风力。

sentences: The heavy ___ caused many trees to fall down in our neighborhood.

image_prompts: A weather vane pointing in different directions, indicating both rain and sunshine
An open umbrella beside a pair of sunglasses, representing contrasting weather conditions
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations depicting both rainy and sunny weather conditions.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘下雨和晴朗天气的插图。
words.collocations: promise rain or shine, deliver rain or shine

examples.en: I will be there for you, rain or shine, always as a friend.
examples.cn: 我会在你身边支持你，无论晴雨，永远是朋友。

examples.en: The school team practices every day, rain or shine, for the competition.
examples.cn: 校队每天都训练，风雨无阻，为了比赛。

socratic_questions.question: 如果承诺某件事，无论天气好坏，都会坚持完成，你会用哪个短语来形容？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个短语表示不受任何天气情况的影响，坚持做某事。

sentences: The postman delivers letters, ___ ___, ensuring everyone gets their mail.

image_prompts: A ripple effect spreading across a calm lake after a pebble is dropped
A thermometer showing a rising temperature, indicating a change in condition
words.image_desc_en: Ripple effect in water; Rising thermometer.
words.image_desc_cn: 水中的涟漪效应；温度计上升。
words.collocations: affect greatly, affect negatively, directly affect

examples.en: The heavy rain may affect our school sports meeting next week.
examples.cn: 下周的大雨可能会影响我们学校的运动会。

examples.en: Did the sad movie affect you a lot last night at home?
examples.cn: 昨晚在家看那部悲伤的电影是否深深地感动了你？

socratic_questions.question: 如果某件事让你感到悲伤或快乐，或者改变了你的计划，它对你做了什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示产生变化或影响。

sentences: The test results did not ___ his overall grade in English class.

image_prompts: A cracked desert landscape with parched earth and withered plants
A clothesline with freshly washed clothes blowing in the wind, sun shining brightly
words.image_desc_en: A cracked desert landscape and clothes drying on a line.
words.image_desc_cn: 干裂的沙漠景观和晾在绳子上的衣服。
words.meaning_cn: adj. 干燥的；v. 使干燥
words.usage: adj. / v. (过去式 dried, 过去分词 dried)
words.collocations: dry air, dry land, dry clothes, dry your hands

examples.en: The weather here is very dry in the summer months.
examples.cn: 这里的夏天天气非常干燥。

examples.en: Please dry your hands with a clean towel after washing them.
examples.cn: 洗完手后请用干净的毛巾擦干。

socratic_questions.question: 描述一下长时间没有下雨，土地和植物会变成什么样子？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 土地缺少水分，植物会枯萎。

sentences: The towels are hung outside to ___ in the sun.
After the rain, the ground began to ___ quickly.

image_prompts: A jagged bolt of lightning illuminating a dark, stormy sky over a field
A time-lapse photo of lightning striking a tall metal tower during a thunderstorm
words.image_desc_en: Images depicting lightning bolts during a storm.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘暴风雨中闪电的图像。
words.collocations: lightning strike, lightning bolt, fork lightning

examples.en: The sudden lightning scared me during the heavy rain last night.
examples.cn: 昨晚大雨中突然的闪电吓了我一跳。

examples.en: A lightning strike caused a power outage in our neighborhood.
examples.cn: 一道闪电导致我们社区停电。

socratic_questions.question: 在雷雨天气中，你看到天空中突然出现一道亮光，并伴随着巨大的声响，那是什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这种自然现象通常发生在暴风雨中，是一种强大的放电现象。

sentences: The tree was split in half by a powerful ___ strike.

image_prompts: Dark clouds swirling above a turbulent ocean, lightning striking the water
A weather map showing a large area of low pressure and heavy precipitation
words.image_desc_en: A stormy scene with dark clouds and lightning, or a weather map indicating a storm.
words.image_desc_cn: 狂风暴雨的场景，乌云密布，电闪雷鸣；或者一张显示大范围低气压和强降水的地图。
words.collocations: stormy weather, stormy relationship, stormy sea
words.preposition_combos: during a stormy night, in stormy conditions

examples.en: The weather was stormy, so we stayed inside all day.
examples.cn: 天气很糟糕，所以我们一整天都待在室内。

examples.en: They had a stormy argument, and now they are not talking.
examples.cn: 他们激烈地争吵了一番，现在他们不说话了。

socratic_questions.question: 描述一种天气，天空乌云密布，风很大，可能会下雨或下雪。
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这种天气通常伴随着强风和降水。

sentences: The boat struggled in the ___ sea during the hurricane.

image_prompts: A compass pointing towards the northern direction, with a snowy landscape in the background
A map highlighting the northern part of a country, with mountains and forests
words.image_desc_en: A compass pointing north and a map highlighting the northern region.
words.image_desc_cn: 指向北方的指南针和突出显示北部区域的地图。
words.collocations: north wind, north pole, north of
words.preposition_combos: to the north of, in the north

examples.en: The wind is blowing from the north, so it will be cold.
examples.cn: 风从北方吹来，所以会很冷。

examples.en: Our school is in the north of the city, near the park.
examples.cn: 我们的学校在城市的北部，靠近公园。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你站在地图的最上方，通常指的是哪个方向？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 地图上方通常代表一个方位，与南相对。

sentences: Canada is to the ___ of the United States.

image_prompts: A compass pointing towards the west direction, sunset in the background
A map showing the western part of a country, mountains and deserts
words.image_desc_en: A compass pointing west and a map showing a country's western region.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个指向西方的指南针和一张显示一个国家西部地区的地图。
words.collocations: go west, west coast, west side

examples.en: The sun sets in the west, creating beautiful colors in the sky.
examples.cn: 太阳在西方落下，在天空中创造出美丽的色彩。

examples.en: Our school is located in the west part of the city.
examples.cn: 我们的学校位于城市的西部。

socratic_questions.question: 太阳落山的方向是哪个方向？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 太阳落山的方向，与东方相对。

sentences: They traveled ___ to explore new national parks during their vacation.

image_prompts: A compass pointing towards the south direction, map in the background
A flock of birds flying towards a sunny southern horizon, open sky
words.image_desc_en: A compass pointing south and birds flying to the south.
words.image_desc_cn: 指南针指向南方，鸟群飞向南方。
words.collocations: south of, go south, south wind
words.preposition_combos: to the south of, from the south

examples.en: Our school is in the south of the city, near the river.
examples.cn: 我们学校在城市的南部，靠近河边。

examples.en: The south wind brought warm air and sunshine to our town.
examples.cn: 南风给我们的城镇带来了温暖的空气和阳光。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你站在中国的最下面，你面向的是哪个方向？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 中国地图的最下方通常代表一个方位。

sentences: The temperature is warmer in the ___ than in the north.

image_prompts: A compass pointing towards the east direction, sunrise in the background
A map highlighting the eastern part of a country, geographical features
words.image_desc_en: A compass pointing east; a map highlighting the eastern region.
words.image_desc_cn: 指向东方的指南针；突出显示东部地区的地图。
words.collocations: go east, east coast, east wind
words.preposition_combos: in the east, to the east of

examples.en: The sun rises in the east every morning, bringing new light.
examples.cn: 太阳每天早上从东方升起，带来新的光芒。

examples.en: Our school is located in the east part of the city now.
examples.cn: 我们的学校现在位于城市的东部。

socratic_questions.question: 太阳从哪个方向升起？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 与太阳升起的方向有关，是地图上的一个方位。

sentences: The beautiful beach is on the ___ coast of the island.

image_prompts: A cozy living room with a fireplace and a book on the coffee table
A board game set up on a table, surrounded by comfortable cushions
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations depicting the concept of remaining indoors.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘了留在室内的概念的插图。
words.usage: v. (过去式 stayed in, 过去分词 stayed in)
words.collocations: stay in bed, stay in shape, stay in touch
words.preposition_combos: stay in a hotel, stay in the city

examples.en: I prefer to stay in on rainy days and read books.
examples.cn: 下雨天我更喜欢待在家里读书。

examples.en: We decided to stay in because the weather was terrible.
examples.cn: 因为天气太糟糕了，我们决定待在家里。

socratic_questions.question: 如果外面刮风下雨，你不想出门，你会怎么做？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 描述的是一种不外出，停留在某个地方的状态。

sentences: Let's ___ tonight and watch a movie; I'm too tired to go out.

image_prompts: A four-leaf clover in a field of three-leaf clovers, sunlight shining
A winning lottery ticket with bold numbers and a large jackpot amount
words.image_desc_en: A four-leaf clover and a winning lottery ticket.
words.image_desc_cn: 四叶草和中奖彩票。
words.collocations: lucky charm, lucky number, feel lucky

examples.en: I feel so lucky to have such supportive friends in school.
examples.cn: 我感到非常幸运，在学校里有这么多支持我的朋友。

examples.en: It was very lucky for him that he found his lost wallet.
examples.cn: 他很幸运，找到了丢失的钱包。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你捡到一个钱包，里面有很多钱，你觉得怎么样？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 描述一种意外获得好处或避免坏事的感觉。

sentences: She felt very ___ to have passed the difficult exam easily.

image_prompts: A winning lottery ticket lying on a table with scattered confetti
A four-leaf clover growing in a field of grass, sunlight shining on it
words.image_desc_en: A lottery ticket and a four-leaf clover, representing good fortune.
words.image_desc_cn: 一张彩票和一片四叶草，代表着好运。
words.usage: 短语；用于表达对他人好运的羡慕或祝贺。
words.collocations: lucky day, lucky charm, lucky number

examples.en: You won the first prize? Lucky you! I'm so jealous.
examples.cn: 你中了头奖？你真幸运！我太嫉妒了。

examples.en: You got tickets to the concert? Oh, lucky you! Have fun.
examples.cn: 你弄到演唱会门票了？哦，你真幸运！玩得开心。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你的朋友在考试中取得了满分，你会对他说什么来表达羡慕？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 表达对他人获得意外好结果的羡慕。

sentences: You found a hundred dollars? ___! I wish I had that luck.

image_prompts: A beach umbrella casting a shadow on a sandy beach, with a towel laid out
A lounge chair on a patio next to a swimming pool, with sunglasses on the chair
words.image_desc_en: A scene suggesting relaxation and exposure to the sun.
words.image_desc_cn: 暗示放松和暴露在阳光下的场景。
words.collocations: sunbathe on the beach, sunbathe by the pool

examples.en: We like to sunbathe on the beach during our summer vacation.
examples.cn: 我们喜欢在暑假期间在海滩上晒日光浴。

examples.en: She decided to sunbathe by the pool to get a tan.
examples.cn: 她决定在泳池边晒日光浴，以便晒黑。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你想让皮肤颜色变深，你会做什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个活动通常在阳光充足的地方进行，目的是为了让皮肤吸收阳光。

sentences: They love to ___ on the beach when they go to Hawaii.

image_prompts: A calendar page with a circled date far in the future, shimmering light
A winding road disappearing into a bright, hopeful sunrise
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations representing a future date and a hopeful journey.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表未来日期和充满希望的旅程的插图。
words.usage: adv. 在将来的某个时候
words.collocations: in some day, some day soon

examples.en: I hope to travel to Europe some day after graduation.
examples.cn: 我希望毕业后将来某一天能去欧洲旅行。

examples.en: Some day, I will learn to play the guitar very well.
examples.cn: 将来某一天，我会学会弹吉他，而且弹得很好。

socratic_questions.question: 你有没有一个长远的梦想，你希望在未来的某个时间实现它？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个梦想不是现在就能实现的，需要等待一个未来的时间点。

sentences: I believe that ___ I will achieve my goals with hard work.

image_prompts: A thermometer showing a high reading, indicating heat
A graph displaying fluctuating readings over time, illustrating change
words.image_desc_en: A thermometer and a temperature graph.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个温度计和一个温度变化的图表。
words.collocations: high temperature, low temperature, body temperature
words.preposition_combos: at a temperature of, below a temperature of

examples.en: The doctor checked my temperature because I felt feverish today.
examples.cn: 医生检查了我的体温，因为我今天感觉发烧了。

examples.en: The temperature will rise tomorrow, so we can go to swim.
examples.cn: 明天气温将会升高，所以我们可以去游泳。

socratic_questions.question: 当你感觉很热或者很冷的时候，你会用什么词来描述空气的冷热程度？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词描述的是冷热的程度，可以用仪器测量。

sentences: The oven's ___ must be set correctly to bake the cake well.

image_prompts: A carrot nose and coal eyes stuck on a large snowball figure in a snowy field
A top hat and scarf adorning a figure made of snow in a winter landscape
words.image_desc_en: A figure made of snow, often with a carrot nose and a hat.
words.image_desc_cn: 用雪堆成的，通常有胡萝卜鼻子和帽子的人形。
words.collocations: build a snowman, snowman decoration
words.preposition_combos: snowman in the yard, snowman with a hat

examples.en: We built a snowman in our garden during the winter holiday.
examples.cn: 我们在寒假期间在花园里堆了一个雪人。

examples.en: The snowman stood tall, watching over the snow-covered landscape.
examples.cn: 雪人高高地站立着，俯视着被雪覆盖的景色。

socratic_questions.question: 冬天，孩子们喜欢在雪地里堆什么，它通常有胡萝卜鼻子和纽扣眼睛？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 它是由雪做成的，形状像人。

sentences: The children were excited to build a ___ after the heavy snowfall.

image_prompts: A row of snowmen in a snowy field, each with a carrot nose and coal eyes
Three snowmen of different sizes standing in a winter garden, wearing hats and scarves
words.image_desc_en: Images of snowmen
words.image_desc_cn: 雪人的图片
words.usage: 名词 n. (snowman 的复数形式)
words.collocations: build snowmen, row of snowmen, funny snowmen
words.preposition_combos: snowmen in the garden, snowmen near the house

examples.en: We built two funny snowmen in the park last winter.
examples.cn: 去年冬天我们在公园里堆了两个有趣的雪人。

examples.en: The children made snowmen after the heavy snowfall yesterday.
examples.cn: 昨天大雪过后，孩子们堆了雪人。

socratic_questions.question: 下雪后，孩子们喜欢在户外用雪堆什么？通常有鼻子和眼睛。
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 通常在冬天用雪堆成，有人的形状。

sentences: The kids enjoyed making ___ in the yard during winter vacation.

image_prompts: A dark rain cloud pouring rain onto a street, creating large puddles
A weightlifter struggling to lift a barbell with many weights, face strained
words.image_desc_en: Rain falling heavily; a weightlifter lifting heavily.
words.image_desc_cn: 雨下得很大；一个举重运动员举得很重。
words.collocations: rain heavily, rely heavily on

examples.en: It rained heavily last night, so the ground is wet now.
examples.cn: 昨晚雨下得很大，所以现在地面是湿的。

examples.en: The box was so full that I breathed heavily after lifting it.
examples.cn: 箱子太满了，我搬起来后喘得很厉害。

socratic_questions.question: 如果雨下得非常大，大到你几乎看不清东西，你会用哪个词来形容下雨的状态？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示雨量很大，程度很深。

sentences: The team relied ___ on their star player to win the game.

image_prompts: A landscape covered entirely in fresh, untouched snow, glistening in sunlight
A snow-covered mountain range with pine trees heavily laden with snow
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations depicting scenes covered in snow.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘被雪覆盖的场景的插图。
words.collocations: snowy day, snowy mountain, snowy weather
words.preposition_combos: on a snowy day, in a snowy area

examples.en: We decided to stay home because it was a snowy day.
examples.cn: 因为是下雪天，我们决定待在家里。

examples.en: The children enjoyed playing in the snowy garden yesterday afternoon.
examples.cn: 昨天下午孩子们在白雪皑皑的花园里玩得很开心。
